title: Conditional tape write
statement: For an optional optional Boolean symbol $w$, a tape contents function $\tau:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, and a position $z\in\mathbb{Z}$, define the updated tape to be unchanged if $w$ is absent; if $w$ is present, replace the contents at $z$ by its inner optional symbol and leave all other positions unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is an optional optional Boolean symbol
$\tau$ maps integer positions to optional Boolean symbols
